params.caption: 🖥️ Microsoft's own upscaler arrives on the Xbox Ally X Microsoft's in-house upscaling tech, an alternative to AMD's FSR, is now available on Xbox Ally X handhelds. It runs on the device's NPU, giving that AI chip a real gaming job, though FSR is still the better pick where a game supports it well. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 15:11 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer #Xbox #PCGaming #GamingNews
